float_vs_gnuradio.rationale: One complex product per sample in float32 on both sides: difference below 1e-7 (rounding of 4 products).

fixed_vs_float.rationale: Exact products at Q30 rounded once to Q15 (at most 2^-16 per component, plus the half LSB of the saturation edge); inputs are Q15 exactly, so the float side is exact too up to float32 rounding. Bound 2^-14 covers the 2 LSB worst case.
As q15_nearest but truncation: up to one LSB (2^-15) below the float value per component.
